style: Possession-oriented and creative through a Champions League-laden midfield, with set-piece threat and a veteran box presence up top.
recent_form: Reigning Nations League champions and FIFA's fifth-ranked side; opened the group stage with a 1-1 draw against DR Congo.

key_players.name: Cristiano Ronaldo
key_players.note: At 41, appearing in a record sixth World Cup; all-time leading men's international scorer.

key_players.name: Bruno Fernandes
key_players.note: Carries the creative load, takes set pieces and penalties; central to everything Martinez builds.

key_players.name: Vitinha
key_players.note: Arrives off a Champions League win with PSG; controls midfield rhythm.

key_players.name: Nuno Mendes
key_players.note: Champions League winner providing pace and overlap down the left.

key_players.name: Joao Neves
key_players.note: Energetic PSG midfielder linking defence and attack.

key_players.name: Goncalo Ramos
key_players.note: Clinical PSG striker offering a mobile alternative to Ronaldo.

historical_news: Euro 2016 and UEFA Nations League champions, but never a World Cup title.
Ronaldo's sixth and final World Cup is a dominant legacy narrative.
Golden generation of PSG Champions League winners (Vitinha, Neves, Mendes, Ramos).
Recurring debate over balancing Ronaldo with a deep, youthful supporting cast.
History of underperforming knockout expectations despite elite talent.

media_sentiment.label: positive
media_sentiment.summary: Seen as dark-horse contenders with elite depth, though an opening draw drew some criticism.
